result.subject: Welcome to Our London Office – Monday 23 November
result.body:
Dear Big-four audit firm team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Monday 23 November at 13:00 for a due diligence session.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Upon arrival, please proceed to the reception on the ground floor and present photo ID to collect building passes. The nearest stations are Liverpool Street (6 min walk) and Moorgate (8 min). Guest Wi‑Fi details will be displayed on the welcome screen in your meeting room.

You will be received by our CFO in Meeting room 2.

Agenda:
- Welcome and introductions
- Company and control-environment overview
- Document walkthrough and Q&A
- Follow-up requests and next steps

Kind regards,
Business Operations
